laws.rule: Coimbra charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 1 per guest per night (about A$1.59, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) for guests aged 16 and over, up to three consecutive nights. The council executive approved a rise to EUR 2 in July 2026; no start date was found.
laws.heading: Câmara Municipal de Coimbra, Taxa Municipal Turística

sources.title: Executivo aprovou atualização da Taxa Municipal Turística para dois euros

local-law.note: Recheck when the EUR 2 rate takes effect.
